New exact head: `4353f6163529a9ff93550504587deb299a87bb2a`
Tree: `5ca1896ded63fc4a1a8bf5967891b50f5766dd58`

1. Part ownership is now a checked-in, full-corpus terminal decision authority rather than builder inference.
   - 264 classifications have explicit candidate-part QP/MS anchors plus exact source excerpt refs.
   - 105 are reviewed and 159 are unresolved; unresolved decisions emit zero part edges and zero instances.
   - Reviewed authority is enforced as 69 single-score-owning-part structural decisions, 27 unique explicit-cue decisions, and 9 allowlisted manual source audits.
   - The superseded audit reconciles exactly to 29 cue / 104 classifier / 130 fallback / 1 forced-continuation cases. All 104 classifier cases are unresolved. All 130 fallback cases are terminal; only independently structural single-part or named manual audits are admitted. `part_ownership_fallback_authority_count = 0`.
   - Named false owners now bind to `s18 q08/i`, `s22 q10/a`, `s23 q09/a`, `w21 q08/a`, and `s17 q07/i`.

2. Part-scoped role and candidate isolation are now fail closed.
   - Every emitted part has exactly one `classification_role: primary`; predecessor question role is preserved separately as `predecessor_classification_role`.
   - `q07/b` is therefore genuinely part-primary/by-parts while retaining predecessor-secondary lineage; its composition role remains independently `supporting`.
   - Runtime no longer promotes `permitted[0]` to primary.
   - Explicit-part candidate state comes only from that part edge. `m25 q03/a` is unavailable in both approved and candidate-preview scopes, while question-only and explicit `q03/b` select the actual candidate-bound part.

Recomputed release: 105 part edges across 105 unique parts, 55 approved material ProcedureInstances (54 core / 1 supporting), 6 step instances, 164 incidental reviews, and 100% approved composition readback (55/55).

Verification: #1722 Python 10/10; deterministic rebuild PASS; authenticated service/API 25/25; #1714 15/15; #1719 suite PASS; #1716 byte-identical; #1719 readback PASS; #1339 6/6; ESLint, artifact index, A+ ratchet, preflight, and diff hygiene PASS/healthy.
